text:
alex_r: Copying follow-ups from the postmortem thread 1h ago. We need to turn remediations into CI/regression coverage so we don't regress again.
sana: Agreed. Can you paste the distilled root causes so we can map tests?
alex_r: Root causes we logged: (A) KV TTL miscalculation -> stale keys and delayed eviction under sustained high QPS, (B) canary model config skew (tokenizer/quant mismatch) causing deserialization errors for fallback, (C) autoscaler pacing jitter causing intermittent cold starts and longer tail latency.
tom_h: For (A) I'd add a sustained-ramp load test + targeted ttl burn chaos. I can own adding the load profile and the chaos script.
meera: For (B) I can own a deterministic model-consistency eval that runs both the canary and baseline on the same seed/prompt ordering and diffs outputs. We'll gate on a strict token-level delta.
sana: And for (C) I'll add an autoscaler soak and a PR-blocking test for any change touching scale/queue logic.
ops-bot: Quick reminder: create follow-up ticket with labels "incident-followup" and "tests-required". Use template "pm-followup->testplan".
alex_r: Action list I'm proposing: 
- KV TTL chaos + sustained ramp (owner: tom_h) 16h to initial smoke, full run by EOW. Chaos: `chaosctl attack kv-ttl-burn --pool serving-main --rps-schedule ramp:1-500:15m --duration 30m`
- Model-consistency eval (owner: meera) 100 prompt pairs, fixed seed, quant vs full, gate if token-diff > 2%
- Autoscaler soak + PR guard (owner: sana) 10m steady-state then spike; fail PR if p99 cold-start > 500ms
- Prompt normalization unit tests + incident promptset (owner: alex_r) 150 edge prompts from traces, path: eng-ml/evals/promptsets/incident-2026-03-ttl
- CI rollout guard (owner: meera) 1 add a job that runs model-consistency on canary after deploy and auto-rollback if gate fails
sana: Where do we check results? Can we push eval summaries to #eng-ml-evals and to the follow-up ticket?
meera: Yes. I'll make the eval runner post JSON summaries + a small human readable table to #eng-ml-evals and attach artifacts to the ticket. If the diff crosses the gate we'll auto-open an issue with label `eval/regression`.
tom_h: Timeline proposals:
- Today/Tomorrow: KV chaos smoke + collect traces (owner: tom_h) 
- 3 days: initial model-consistency draft + nightly job set up (owner: meera)
- 1 week: autoscaler soak and PR guard merged (owner: sana)
- 2 weeks: attach CI rollout guard and update rollout playbook (owner: meera)
alex_r: I'll file the follow-up ticket and add this checklist.
ops-bot: Actionable ticket created: INF-1248. Linking postmortem doc and assigning owners. Reminder: set due dates on assignees.
meera: Notes on eval specifics: deterministic ordering, fixed RNG seed, temperature=0.0 for generation, compare at token and sequence-level metrics, persist raw outputs for forensic diffs.
sana: Autoscaler soak plan: 10m ramp to 80% capacity, 5m plateau, 5m spike to 200% QPS. Capture cold-start histogram and queue depth traces.
tom_h: I'm adding the ramp profile to load-harness as `ramp-sustained-15m`. Marking it as part of weekly soak matrix so it runs on the staging cluster every Tue.
alex_r: Promptset curation: I'll pull 150 high-variance prompts from the incident traces and add 50 synthetic edge cases. PR will target eng-ml/evals/promptsets/incident-2026-03-ttl by Thu.
meera: I'll make the CI gate create a rollback plan link in the created issue so SRE oncall can trigger a safe rollback if needed.
ops-bot: Friendly: flagging repeating pattern: TTL/eviction incidents observed 4 times in last 6 months. Consider adding monthly targeted soak.
meera: Good point. I'll propose adding the `ramp-sustained-15m` to the monthly stress run and update the runbook.
sana: I'll own the PR for autoscaler PR guard and link to INF-1248.
tom_h: KV chaos smoke in progress, will post traces once the artifacts are uploaded.
meera: Draft of the quant vs full eval repo PR will be up by Monday and I'll wire the GitHub Action to run nightly for a week post-merge.
alex_r: Thanks all. Please drop short status updates here when each milestone completes so we can close the follow-up ticket faster. :thumbsup:
